generators.carrier: d-dim complex Hilbert space, trace inner product

relations.statement: tr(P_bj P_b'j') = delta_bb' delta_jj' + (1-delta_bb')/d, for rank-one projectors of distinct bases
relations.hypotheses: complete MUB family; rank-one projectors; d+1 bases

relations.statement: sum_bj P_bj = (d+1) I - wait: each basis resolves I, so sum over d+1 bases equals (d+1) I
relations.hypotheses: each basis is a projector resolution of identity

lemmas.statement: The d(d+1) projectors span the d^2-dimensional operator space with d+1 linear relations from the resolutions, giving d^2 + 1 -1 independent elements, so the projectors span all operators
rho = sum_bj tr(rho P_bj) P_bj - I for trace-one rho

near_misses.claim: rho = sum_bj p_bj P_bj without subtracting I
near_misses.rejecting_invariant: Trace: tr of sum is d+1, but tr rho = 1, so I must be subtracted

near_misses.claim: Only d MUB bases suffice for reconstruction
near_misses.rejecting_invariant: Dimension count: d(d-1)+... independent parameters give d^2-1 < needed; d bases give d(d-1) < d^2-1 for d>1
